integrity_statement: All assertions are supported by the displayed analytic proof; finite symbolic or rational checks corroborate but do not replace infinite arguments. The prior literature is cited without claiming independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the Euclidean complex plane, a specified upper-triangular family and fixed-epsilon limits. It establishes failure of the normal-class sqrt(2) upper bound, not a universal nonnormal upper constant or an exact finite-coupling shadowability formula. Complete comparison with the 2023 Morales–Nguyen article is restricted by unavailable full text.
title: Two-dimensional nonnormal shadowing–robustness ratios approach two
